Late Tulsidas Sakhre Aged About 35 Years R/o  House No. 106/6, Type-2, WRS Colony, PS Khamtarai, Tahsil and  District Raipur (C.G.) Mo. No. 6260368313  ------Applicant  VERSUS  State of Chhattisgarh through: P.S. Khamhardih, Dist. Raipur, C.G.
 -------Non-applicant  For Applicant : Mr. N.Naha Roy, Advocate.
For Non-applicant : Mr. G.I. Sharan, Govt. Advocate
Single Bench: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge  ORDER 20/01/2023 1.
Learned counsel for applicant submits that this is Fourth Bail application filed on behalf of applicant.

Applicant filed this application under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 54/2020 registered at Police Station- Khamhardih,
District Raipur (C.G.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC.

2. Case of prosecution is, that applicant along with seven other co- accused persons based on fake and concocted documents impersonated himself to be Pawan Kumar Pandey has obtained loan amount of Rs. 2,24,20,000/- and also got loan sanction of Rs. 11,00,000/-.

After getting the knowledge of fraud committed by applicant and other co-accused person, Branch Manager of Indian Overseas Bank, lodged the report to the concerned police station based upon which applicant and other co-accused persons were arrested.

3. Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant is pressing this bail application on the ground of delay in trial, and 06 applicants have been enlarged on regular bail by the High Court in different bail applications.
Case of applicant is on same footings.
He contended that applicant was arrested on 18.03.2020 and since then he is in jail and thereby completed 02 years and 10 months of his pre-trial detention.
Applicant is a resident of Raipur, hence, there is no likelihood of his absconding.

4. Learned State counsel opposes the submission of learned counsel for applicant and would submit Pranay Sakhre vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122681618/
1 that according to the decision of the bail application of other co-accused, total value of money which the applicant along with other co-accused person committed fraud comes to a huge amount of Rs.
2,24,20,000/- and he was involved in more than one offences, hence, he is not entitled for grant of bail.

entities.text: Pranay Sakhre vs State Of Chhattisgarh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, he does not dispute the submission that other co-accused involved with applicant in the alleged crime have already been enlarged on regular bail by the High Court.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

6. Taking into consideration the facts of the case, submission of learned counsel for applicant as well as the State counsel, perusal of order sheet filed along with this bail application wherein it is mentioned that till November 2022 only one witness is partly examined, offence is triable by Judicial Magistrate First Class, conclusion of trial may take some time for its disposal, period of detention, without commenting anything on merits, I am inclined to allow the bail application.
7.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on regular bail, upon furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the Court on the conditions that- a) Applicant shall appear before the Trial Court regularly on each and every date,
unless exempted from appearance.
b) The applicant shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
c) If the applicant is found involved in similar offence in future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of Bail.
Certified copy as per rules.
